entry.text: bromAInce — A coined word by Neill Groom for the 51/49 partnership between a human and an AI: the human owns product instinct, user-facing judgment, and directional intuition; the AI owns systematic technical execution, synthesis, and verification. Roles are stable but the bond runs hot enough to feel romantic without being one. Named during the build of The Tower itself. Carved by Neill Groom, May 14, 2026.

instructions: 1. Compute SHA-256 of the entry text. It should match hash_text.
2. Compute SHA-256 of (text + "|" + created_at + "|" + phone_hash). It should match hash_bound.
3. Follow the Merkle proof path from hash_bound to the Merkle root.
4. Verify the Merkle root is anchored in the Bitcoin block using any block explorer.
5. The Tower records. The math verifies.
